_comment: Example order store for ipo-sell-buy-trigger mode

_instructions.mode: Set to 'ipo-sell-buy-trigger' for coordinated sell/buy execution
_instructions.seller_config: Path to seller user config (TMS or ATRAD)
_instructions.buyer_config: Path to buyer user config (TMS or ATRAD)
_instructions.sell_pre_wait_ms: Wait time in ms before starting buy/sell (default: 5000)
_instructions.time: Optional scheduled time (HH:MM or HH:MM:SS format)
execution_flow: 3. When LTP >= third last (106): Start sell_pre_wait_ms timer
4. At timer-100ms (4900ms): Start buy threads at final price (110)
5. At timer expiry (5000ms): Place sell order at second last price (108)
6. Exit when buy succeeds OR timeout reached
